name: rapier
description: Rapier, the offline document editor, as a Claude plugin: four skills and the MCP door.

plugins.name: rapier
plugins.description: The document editor an agent hands a person and works in beside them: one offline page that is the whole editor with the document inside (write, draw, paint, notes, the diff of a change; no account), the agent door for exact edits at about 1.5 KB of context each under the person's review, and Self-contained Markdown, the open convention that carries pictures, layout and colour in one .md file.
